description: Defines the ocudu::slot_point class and related constants, types, and functions for handling radio slot timing and numerology in a 3GPP-like system.

classes.name: ocudu::slot_point
classes.description: Represents a radio slot point with timing, numerology, and SFN information, supporting wrap-around, comparison, and conversion functionalities.

methods.name: ocudu::set_slot_numerology
methods.description: Converts a slot_point to a different numerology, applying floor operation when converting to a lower numerology.
